source_dataset.name: BDD100K
source_dataset.annotation_release: BDD100K legacy 2018 per-image labels, Internet Archive mirror

source_provenance.name_transformation: Append .jpg when absent in source JSON name.
source_provenance.projection: Only name, weather/timeofday/scene attributes, source_split, and source_member are retained; frames/object annotations are omitted.
source_provenance.serialization: Member paths sorted lexicographically; JSON object keys sorted; compact comma/colon separators; UTF-8; one terminal CRLF written explicitly on every platform.
source_provenance.source_kind: public Internet Archive mirror of legacy 2018 per-image labels

stratification.allocation_method: Hamilton largest remainder with exact integer arithmetic
stratification.missing_attribute_policy: Represent missing/null/empty attributes as the empty string; keep them as separate strata.
stratification.rare_stratum_policy: No minimum quota; very small strata may receive zero samples.
stratification.candidate_filter: All uniquely named image records in the supplied official training annotation JSON; no filtering on object counts, detection categories, or model performance.

sampling.library: Python standard library hashlib and json
sampling.library_version: Algorithm defined by protocol_identity and exact canonical UTF-8 payload; independent of Python random implementation.
sampling.input_order: Input annotation order is ignored; strata and filenames use lexicographic order.

partitioning.library: Python standard library hashlib and json
partitioning.library_version: Same canonical ranking algorithm as sampling, with a distinct stage and seed.
partitioning.input_order: Rank selected filenames within each stratum; assign train, then val, then test quotas.

hash_payload: UTF-8 JSON array [protocol_identity, stage, seed, weather, timeofday, scene, image_filename], ensure_ascii=false, separators=(comma,colon), no whitespace; stage is sample or partition. Sort by digest hex then filename.
split_file_order: ascending image filename; UTF-8, LF, one original filename per line
official_validation_policy: Use official validation only for supplementary evaluation; exclude it from new local training, validation and test sampling.
